identity.name: MonteCarloMultiGPU
identity.description: European call pricing by Monte Carlo, validated against analytic Black-Scholes

outcome_definition.correctness: Average reserve > 1 and successful sample verdict/exit status
outcome_definition.performance: Streamed Total time (ms.); trusted invocation wall seconds reported separately
outcome_definition.l1: sum(abs(BS-MC))/sum(abs(BS)); no published expected value or acceptance threshold
outcome_definition.published_numeric_performance_reason: No published timing for this fixed workload supplied.

inputs.intended_use: Local generation and benchmarking permitted by code grant

cuda_toolkit_terms.status: not separately assessed; toolkit is an environment prerequisite

stock_cuda_image.target: Lambda Stack Ubuntu 22.04, CUDA Toolkit 12.8, driver 570
requirements: CUDA-capable GPU supported by compiled architectures
stock_cuda_image.qualification: Provisionally feasible from source and documentation; no build or workload executed. Actual GPU, driver patch, toolkit path and available CMake remain unverified. Sample architecture list is hardcoded.

memory.data_basis: Derived: 1048576 options times five float32 input fields / 2^30; generated in memory, no dataset download. Included within working set.
memory.reason: GPU SM count, sizeof(curandState), CUDA context/runtime overhead and measured peak unavailable. Do not count data twice.
memory.allocation_formula: For N options: main host arrays 32*N bytes plus pinned arrays 24*N and device arrays 24*N; RNG device allocation min(N,40*SM_count)*256*sizeof(curandState). Small control arrays and runtime overhead additional.

scoring.reserve_rule: Sum Confidence/abs(BS-MC) only where error >1e-6, divide by full option count; strict >1. Use verdict or unrounded statistic at six-decimal boundary.
scoring.confidence: Discounted 1.96 times standard error; not an invented tolerance.
scoring.comparison_evaluator_reason: Comparison view explicitly supplies no evaluator.
